cultural.vision_reason: A handwoven strip-cloth blanket with narrow stripes and supplementary-weave diamond motifs in a central panel, composed of narrow strips machine-sewn selvedge to selvedge — a classic West African strip-weaving construction consistent with Mende textile tradition in Sierra Leone.

physical.title: cloth; blanket
physical.summary: Blanket; textile; furnishing; hand-woven cotton and synthetic fibres composed of seven narrow strips machine sewn selvedge to selvedge forming a rectangular shape with an unworked warp fringe. Plain weave; white and black machine spun cotton warp; dyed buff, brown, blue, green, light blue and cream cotton and wefts. The majority of the decoration is in bands that are part of the ground weave. These bands are in a number of combinations of the following colours: dyed buff, brown, blue, green, light blue and cream. There are also three bands which are decorated with supplementary weave: 1.Diamond based pattern in blue; 2.Diamond and polygon based pattern in blue; 3.Diamond based pattern in blue.
